scripts.dev: concurrently -k -s first -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:open: sh -c 'URL=http://127.0.0.1:${WEB_PORT:-46923}; (sleep 2; open "$URL") & exec npm run dev'
scripts.dev:web: sh -c 'PORT=${WEB_PORT:-46923} NEXT_HOST=127.0.0.1 npm --prefix web run dev'
